All Implemented Interfaces:
javax.accessibility.Accessible, java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.MenuContainer, javax.swing.RootPaneContainer, java.io.Serializable, javax.swing.WindowConstants
public class RemoteFileChooser
extends javax.swing.JDialog

Title: BHP Viewer

Description: This class provides general behavior and gui representation for choosing a remote file on the server. It uses servlet servletReadDirectory to read a directory and displays all its content in a list. When using this class, a subclass of this one needs to be created implementing the abstrace method execute. This method is where the selected file will be handled. This abstrace dialog can be used for both file openning and file saving.
